provenance.rebuilt: CCCBDB's Cartesian table disagrees with its own listed parameters (rCCl (1, 3): listed 1.762, Cartesians give 1.7670; aClCCl (3, 1, 4): listed 110.92, Cartesians give 108.5279; aHCCl (2, 1, 3): listed 107.98, Cartesians give 110.3989), so the Cartesians were rebuilt from the listed parameters by a least-squares fit.
